annotation.title_clean: Responsible Personalisation: The Double-Edged Sword of Personalisation in Human-Robot Interaction
annotation.title_en: Responsible Personalisation: The Double-Edged Sword of Personalisation in Human-Robot Interaction
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Andriella, A.; Nasir, J.; Rezzani, A.; Kubota, A.; Lacroix, D.; Love, T.
annotation.summary_en: Preprint proposing a lifecycle-based, context-sensitive framework for responsible personalisation in human-robot interaction, drawing on expert workshop debates. It analyses embodiment-amplified ethical risks (autonomy erosion, biased user models, manipulation, dehumanisation, privacy violations) and offers design recommendations and open research questions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Six-phase personalisation lifecycle: design, data collection, modelling, interaction, evaluation, end-of-life.
Context classification: short- vs long-term, open- vs closed-domain interactions.
Embodiment amplifies risks such as privacy, manipulation and autonomy erosion beyond HCI.
Identifies autonomy erosion, biased user modelling, manipulation, dehumanisation and privacy violations.
Provides design recommendations and open research questions for responsible personalised robots.
